author: Pixar
description:
Meet Bobby Podesta, the first animator to work on Pixar's "CARS," back in 2003! Bobby shares some of the earliest tests ever as he helped figure out how the cars in "Cars" would actually move, talk, and more! Do you have questions for Bobby and the filmmakers of Cars? Ask us in the comments!
